review.method: Acceptance suite run locally on a machine declaring retail, gpu and audio: step 1 ran the task's own selection (prefix accept_f40_d_) through cargo on this tree. The retail test enumerated GOSDATA/ASSETS/GRAPHICS/MPG, pinned the ten files against the F40-D2 inventory and played every one end to end through the real output device (the device's played position is the master clock), composed each shown frame letterboxed into 1280x720 and rendered three sampled surfaces per file offscreen on the real GPU, comparing each readback with the uploaded surface pixel for pixel (every-cinematic.json and the PNGs are the artifacts). The synthetic tests prove a missing file, a non-MPEG file and a missing audio capability yield named errors and no completion. This harness derives every count and assertion status from the recorded log's prefixed test lines, the fingerprints from production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR and the engine versions from rustc and Cargo.lock. unknowns lists the unresolved items; validate_evidence.py therefore runs without --require-pass. Claim is implemented: no human_play or human_review, no original-run capture, and no agent review replaces the owner's approval
